findings.highlight: The gushing red reminds me of a sudden geyser of water.
findings.evidenceJa: 吹き出す赤は、放水より爆発を思わせる
findings.governingReading: The red eruption suggests an explosion more than a discharge of water.
findings.explanation: An eruption compared more to an explosion than to water becomes a geyser of water. The violent image survives, but the source's contrast disappears.
